description: Capability for the main window. Grants permission to execute the bundled coin-finder sidecar (by its registered externalBin name, sidecar-scoped, with a fixed argument list) plus Tauri's own default core permissions (window/event/webview management etc). No filesystem plugin, no HTTP/network plugin beyond the sidecar itself, no shell access beyond this one named command, no updater, no analytics/telemetry.
